pages.text: To perform the Implementum ritual, simply go to sleep in a bed that is being influenced by your chosen Implement. When you awake, the item will bind itself to you. You will also unlock a new curio slot that can only hold an Implement.

You will find yourself unable to rid yourself of your Implement, even by dying.$(br2)If it is destroyed - by being broken, placed, poured out, eaten, etc. - then you can use the Implement hotkey (i by default) to regenerate it at the cost of some Self.$(br2)Your reach will also be increased while holding your Implement.
